facts.text: The image is a composite creature-design reference sheet: a large cinematic panel spans the top, with seven smaller panels arranged in a middle row of three and a bottom row of four.
The recurring subject is a large dragon with dark, heavily scaled skin that shows blue-green iridescence, especially in the scale-detail panel.
The dragon has several long, pale, ridged horns swept back from its head and a spiked ridge running along its neck, back, and tail.
Its wings are large, dark, bat-like membranes supported by visible finger struts; the top panel shows one wing extended broadly at right.
In the top panel the dragon has a low-slung stance with its head lowered near shallow reflective water in a dark volcanic landscape with jagged peaks, smoke, and scattered orange glowing embers.
The middle row contains three labeled views—FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR—each showing the dragon on a plain dark background.
The bottom row contains four labeled close-ups: HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The HEAD CLOSE panel shows the dragon's head in profile, including an amber eye, horn bases, and detailed facial scales.
The CLAW AND FOOT panel shows a scaly foot ending in large curved claws; the SCALE DETAIL panel shows overlapping dark scales with blue-teal highlights.
The turnaround panels use soft, even studio-style lighting, while the top panel uses low-key cinematic lighting with cool blue-gray highlights and warm orange background glow.

card.summary: A dark fantasy reference sheet presenting one black dragon design across a large cinematic panel and seven labeled turnaround and detail panels.

attributes: dark armored scales with blue-teal iridescence
several long, pale, ridged horns swept back from the head
spiked dorsal ridge running from head to tail
large membranous bat-like wings with visible finger struts
pose: top panel: low stance with head lowered toward shallow water and wings partly spread
front view: facing the viewer with wings raised
side profile: standing in profile with tail extended
rear view: facing away with wings spread

card.environment: Top panel: dark volcanic rocky terrain with shallow reflective water, jagged mountains, smoke, and scattered orange embers or lava glow. Lower panels: plain dark neutral background.
card.lighting: Top panel: low-key cinematic lighting with cool blue-gray rim light and warm orange ember glow. Lower panels: soft, even studio-style illumination.
card.framing: Composite reference sheet: one wide cinematic hero panel across the top, a three-panel turnaround row in the middle, and a four-panel detail row at the bottom.
card.style: High-detail dark fantasy creature concept art; photorealistic digital painting presented as a design reference sheet.
card.characterisation: A massive, ancient-looking dark dragon with iridescent armored scales and prominent swept-back horns.
card.camera: Hero panel viewed from a low, wide creature-level angle; turnaround views framed straight-on; detail panels tightly cropped.

limitations: The sheet combines a cinematic environmental hero panel with plain-background reference views, so a single composition classification is approximate.
Fine surface detail in the darkest areas of the top panel is difficult to resolve.
